_comment: Treasure: maps, wrecks, buried chests. Many are chains: a first event queues a second that waits for you somewhere. See docs/events.md.

treasure_twin_palms.title: The twin palms
treasure_twin_palms.text: {port}. Ashore, beyond the town, two palms lean together exactly as the scrap of chart showed.

choices.result: Spades strike wood. A sea chest, packed with coin of every nation.
choices.fail_result: Two days of digging. Nothing but sand crabs. Either you counted wrong or someone got here first.

choices.text: Sell the map to a local fool
choices.result: He pays eighty and runs off with a spade.

map_seller.title: A treasure map, cheap
map_seller.text: A one-eyed man in the market unrolls a stained chart: 'Spanish gold, Captain, on an island near {port}. Yours for {price} pieces.'

choices.result: The coastline is drawn wrong, the ink is new, and the 'old Spanish' is misspelt. A forgery.
choices.fail_result: It looks genuine enough. You pay.

choices.result: He tries the next captain along.

map_seller_dig.title: The one-eyed man's island
map_seller_dig.text: The island near {port} is just where the chart puts it.

choices.result: Against all odds, a buried strongbox. The forger had a real map after all, or copied one.
choices.fail_result: Nothing but goats. The crew laugh at you behind their hands.

silver_wreck.title: A wreck on the shoals
silver_wreck.text: In clear water over a reef, the outline of an old ship: ribs, ballast stones, and something glinting.

choices.result: Pieces of eight, fused into lumps by the sea. Still silver.
choices.fail_result: A diver comes up too fast, and doesn't come round.

choices.text: Mark the spot and move on
choices.result: You note the bearings in the log.

cursed_coins.title: Aztec gold
cursed_coins.text: {sailor} comes to you pale: the gold coins from the last prize carry strange heathen faces, and the men who handled them have been dreaming of drowning.

choices.result: The dreams stop. So does a share of your fortune.

choices.fail_result: Half the crew won't go below at night.

choices.result: A priest at the next port earns a fat fee.

buried_by_crew.title: Hidden shares
buried_by_crew.text: {sailor} confesses, drunk: some of the crew buried their own shares of plunder on a beach near {port}, rather than trust them to you.

choices.text: Go and dig it up yourself
Say nothing. A man's share is his own
choices.result: Word gets round that you heard and let it be.

hidden_shares_dig.title: The crew's cache
hidden_shares_dig.text: At {port} you slip ashore at night with a lantern and a spade.

choices.result: Three hundred in coin. By morning the whole ship knows.

choices.text: Leave it. Think better of it
